items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: Yeah he played trombone in the onward band with me.

ctx.x: One of the best bands you played around him. Great big brother, Shrappett. He played trombone too. That's what I wanted to ask you about. Yeah he played trombone in the onward band with me. I never did understand how he could just double like that and not have any trouble huh? Well he was a musical in kind. Yeah he was good enough to play in the onward band and he played banjo regular. Yeah he played banjo.
